collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: After a night of rain, the ground around the encampment is covered in mushrooms. (name1) and the other Heathen children run from patch to patch, shrieking every time they find a new kind. An adult follows them with a basket and a long list of which ones not to eat. The Heathens' village gains food. \(no effect\)
